correctness.rationale: Gaussian integration-by-parts for sign-crossing versus squared linear form yields the exact σ²F_n/(π√(1−ρ²)) projector identity, with P=I−11ᵀ/n. The square-completion formula and geometric sum show F_n(0)=2(n−1)/n>0, F_n(1/2)<0 for n≥7 and F_n(1−ε)>0 to second order. Exact Q_n=2(n²−1)/3 and S_n=(n²−1)(3n²−5n+8)/30 give n²F_n(1−c/n²)→2c²/3−c³/10; bulk and small-correlation asymptotics yield other claims. Sign-bracketing and intermediate value establish root sequences, without asserting uniqueness. Independently recalculated exact n=7,8,9 negative fractions, and numerical convergence checks for n=60,120,240 support but do not prove asymptotics.

evidence: Lindgren 1974 studies crossing-related spectral estimators and derivative-square estimators in continuous time; Sinn–Keller covariance of Gaussian zero crossings concerns pairs of crossings; Vladimirov 2014 presents classical Price identities.
